name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduating, he started his career at a smaller racing team, gaining hands-on experience in building and tuning race cars. His meticulous approach and sharp problem-solving skills quickly earned him recognition.

He joined Boutsen VDS a few years ago, bringing a wealth of knowledge in chassis development and aerodynamics. Jean-Pierre is known for his data-driven decision-making and his relentless pursuit of performance improvements. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment within the technical team, but also holds everyone to the highest standards. He is a firm believer that consistent incremental gains lead to significant overall improvements.

Jean-Pierre is recognized for his exceptional ability to diagnose complex technical problems and devise innovative solutions. He is a dedicated and driven technical director who is committed to pushing the team to achieve its full potential. His commitment to excellence is what sets him apart.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height, with a wiry build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas or observations.
Insists on having his workstation perfectly organized before starting any task.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
